title: Accessory Drive Belt Idler Pulley
introduction: An idler pulley is a guide wheel for the accessory drive belt: it helps the belt follow its intended path. This procedure is for the 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS). The job begins by removing the belt, then removing the pulley and its central retaining bolt. Keep the original diagram beside the steps—the blue part is the pulley, and the magenta fastener at its center is the bolt you are working on.

items.name: Accessory drive belt procedure
items.detail: Use the linked belt procedure to remove and reinstall the belt for this engine.

items.name: Torque wrench for the pulley bolt
items.detail: The specified installation tightening value is 93 lb.in (10.5 Nm). This is a capability required by the torque instruction, not a separately listed special tool.

edits.text: Take off the accessory drive belt using [Accessory Drive Belt](#/document/G1688219) (303-05A Accessory Drive - 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS), Removal and Installation).
edits.why: With the belt removed, the idler pulley is free of belt contact.

edits.text: Remove the central retaining bolt and the idler pulley shown in the illustration. When refitting the pulley, tighten this bolt to 93 lb.in (10.5 Nm).
edits.why: The source illustration supplies the action here: blue identifies the pulley to remove/install, and magenta identifies its central fastener. The torque is the tightening value for installation.

edits.text: Refit the components by reversing the removal sequence.
edits.why: Put the pulley and its retaining bolt back in place before reinstalling the belt. Use the tightening value given with the removal illustration.

edits.text: Refit the accessory drive belt using [Accessory Drive Belt](#/document/G1688219) (303-05A Accessory Drive - 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS), Removal and Installation).
edits.why: Follow the linked procedure through its final belt-seating check so the belt follows the intended pulley path.

visualEvidence.interpretation: Original diagram and supplied color legend show the idler pulley as the blue target and its central retaining fastener as magenta. This resolves the action missing from the text-only source step.
